options: No, RF = 128 sees only the last 128 hours, so add a layer (dilation 128 gives RF = 256).

questions.q: A teammate uses padding='same' in a Conv1d forecasting layer. What is the risk?
options: The output at time t can see future values, which leaks the answer.
why: Correct: 'same' pads both sides, so the kernel looks ahead.
It is a serious leakage risk.
